Weekly Monday 7 AM deal call: sharpens focus

Career path:
- 2001: Analyst at Goldman Sachs – M&A modeling, survived dot-com crash

- 31: Vice President – led defining transactions of era

Core insight: In global finance, network and track record are currency. Trust is earned one successful deal at a time.
store.1:
Leadership in finance is about creating a culture of excellence while maintaining humanity. At Legend Investments, I oversee a team of 180 professionals across investment, research, and operations. Leadership pillars: empowerment, accountability, continuous growth. Open-door policy and weekly strategic roundtables foster innovation. A second-year analyst's ESG scoring proposal is now implemented.

Talent: 94% retention. Biweekly mentorship with 3 directors. 15 to top schools. GS/MS talent via accelerated path.
Diversity: 40% senior leadership women/minorities(up from 15%). Partnerships with SEO, Girls Who Invest.

Crisis: 2020 crash. Led team on Saturday. Methodical analysis. On trading floor daily. Key hires. Investor comms during redemptions. Transparency and presence build trust. Leadership tested in storms.

Innovation: Innovation pods(PMs + tech). Chair Innovation Committee. Launched SOAR(AI platform, in-house, diverse team). Fluid org structure. 'Future of Finance' symposium → 3 strategic partnerships.

Social impact: Serve on boards of 3 non-profits(financial literacy, economic empowerment). $50M foundation initiative for scholarships and internships for underprivileged students. Regular speaker at universities and conferences(e.g., Financial Institute National Conference) on ethical leadership. Senior executives spend 2 weeks annually teaching financial skills in underserved communities. This commitment has strengthened culture and attracted mission-driven talent. Leadership is about showing financial success and social responsibility are mutually reinforcing. Focused on developing next-gen leaders who understand sustainable success requires performance and integrity.
